description: This file defines the CodeIndexServiceFactory class responsible for creating and configuring dependencies for code indexing, including embedders, vector stores, directory scanners, and file watchers, based on project configuration.

classes.name: CodeIndexServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating and configuring code indexing service dependencies, including embedders, vector stores, directory scanners, and file watchers, based on project configuration.

methods.name: createEmbedder
methods.description: Creates an embedder instance based on the current configuration, selecting among various provider options such as openai, ollama, gemini, etc.

methods.name: validateEmbedder
methods.description: Validates an embedder instance to ensure it's properly configured, capturing telemetry on errors.

methods.name: createVectorStore
methods.description: Creates a vector store instance using the current configuration, supporting LanceDB and Qdrant providers.

methods.name: createDirectoryScanner
methods.description: Creates a directory scanner instance with dependencies like embedder, vector store, parser, and ignore instance.

methods.name: createFileWatcher
methods.description: Creates a file watcher instance with dependencies including embedder, vector store, cache, ignore, and optional RooIgnoreController.

methods.name: createServices
methods.description: Creates all required service dependencies if the service is properly configured, including embedder, vector store, parser, scanner, and file watcher.
